config.hypothesis: R1 VP_UN is positive on 8/10 domains but misses COCO and ISIC; R4 bidirectional extent objectives failed. Test whether a single scalar on this new field removes both deficits without losing other domains.
config.positive_decision: Freeze the globally selected scalar before first new-500 scoring; independent confirmation is still required.
config.negative_decision: Reject this fixed scalar family as a solution to the ten-domain gap; do not extend the grid or deploy per-domain best thresholds.
config.readout: torch bilinear1024 align_corners=False, unchanged lab.minmax, strict > tau
config.fallback: reference rho>.9: bitwise R1 VP_UN raw-T fallback for every tau, unchanged by calibration
config.fixed_identity: recompute tau=.5 and require packed masks identical to R1 VP_UN for all 1360 before sealing
config.selection: maximize minimum domain class-mIoU delta to FoRIS; then unweighted mean domain delta; then closest tau to .5; then smaller tau as deterministic residual tie-break
config.lodo: repeat identical selection on nine domains; report only held-domain result; diagnostic, not a per-domain deployment rule
config.scoring: all 1360 x 9 masks sealed before query GT; frozen R1 FoRIS and MEAN metrics reused only in scoring

conclusions: No tested single global tau makes all ten domains nonnegative or all at least -0.5 pp vs FoRIS.
The predeclared worst-domain-first criterion selects tau=0.475. It improves ISIC but makes LVIS negative; COCO and ISIC remain negative.
Within the frozen grid, COCO is positive only at 0.55 and 0.575; ISIC is positive only at 0.40, 0.425 and 0.45. These sets do not overlap.
LODO selects 0.5 without ISIC and 0.45 without LVIS; the held-domain deficits are -1.162861 and -0.598230 pp. This does not demonstrate domain-transferable calibration.
This is exposed development evidence. Fixed-arm bootstrap intervals are descriptive and do not adjust for candidate selection. Do not claim universal scalar impossibility beyond this tested family.
